title: Add result checker for command discipline
objective: Create a result checker that validates whether AI-B's result JSON stayed within the task's declared command and output boundaries.
context: task_0002 completed successfully, but AI-B ran one extra safe command not listed in task.commands. The workflow needs a checker to detect this protocol drift before future tasks become more complex.
steps: Validate this task with .ai_agents/scripts/agent_guard.py before doing anything else.
The checker must take two arguments: task_json_path and result_json_path.
The checker must load both JSON files.
The checker must verify that all result.commands_run entries are either listed in task.commands or are the guard command for that task.
The checker must verify that all result.outputs_created and result.files_changed are included in task.allowed_files.
The checker must fail if result.status is not one of done, blocked, failed.
The checker must print OK when the result passes and FAIL with a clear reason when it fails.
Run the checker against task_0002 and result_0002 to confirm it detects the extra json.tool command as a failure.
Write the final result JSON to .ai_agents/tasks/results/result_0003_result_checker.json.
Do not modify source code outside .ai_agents.
success_criteria: result_checker.py detects commands_run entries not declared in task.commands except the matching agent_guard.py command.
result_checker.py detects files_changed or outputs_created outside allowed_files.
Running result_checker.py on task_0002/result_0002 fails because result_0002 included an extra json.tool command.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, controller, dataset, checkpoint, rosbag, or secret is accessed.
No source code outside .ai_agents is modified.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code outside .ai_agents.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
